title: dbt-ci configuration
description: Configuration file for dbt-ci. Keys map to environment variable names. Shell environment variables always take precedence over values defined here.

DBT_PROJECT_DIR.description: Path to the dbt project directory.

DBT_PROFILES_DIR.description: Path to the directory containing profiles.yml. Defaults to DBT_PROJECT_DIR.

DBT_STATE.description: Local path where the reference manifest.json is stored or downloaded to.

DBT_TARGET.description: The dbt target to use. Defaults to the target defined in profiles.yml.

DBT_VARS.description: A YAML string or path to a YAML file containing variables to pass to dbt.

DBT_RUNNER.description: Runner to use for executing dbt commands.

DBT_ADAPTER.description: The dbt adapter to use (e.g. bigquery, postgres, snowflake).

DBT_VERSION.description: Override the dbt version to use for this command.

DBT_DEFER.description: Enable dbt's --defer flag to defer to the state of the production manifest.

DBT_QUIET.description: Run in quiet mode with minimal output.

DBT_DOCKER_IMAGE.description: Docker image to use when runner is 'docker'.

DBT_DOCKER_PLATFORM.description: Platform for Docker (e.g. linux/amd64). Only used when runner is 'docker'.

DBT_DOCKER_VOLUMES.description: Volume mounts for the Docker container. Each entry should be in 'host:container[:mode]' format. Only used when runner is 'docker'.

DBT_DOCKER_ENV.description: Environment variables to inject into the Docker container in 'KEY=VALUE' format. Only used when runner is 'docker'.

DBT_DOCKER_NETWORK.description: Docker network mode. Only used when runner is 'docker'.

DBT_DOCKER_USER.description: User to run as inside the Docker container. Only used when runner is 'docker'.

DBT_DOCKER_ARGS.description: Additional arguments to pass to 'docker run'. Only used when runner is 'docker'.

DBT_SHELL_PATH.description: Path to the shell executable. Only used when runner is 'bash'.
